name: print-social-april-fools-instagram-stories-orange-jester-character
title: April Fools' Instagram story set with an orange jester mascot, balloon and laughing man photos
whatItIs: Five vertical story cards in orange, red, blue and green with a jester-mask logo, photos of a laughing man in green holding a teal heart balloon and party horns, headlines like 'Let's Have Fun' and 'So Sweet is Your Smile', and confetti scattered throughout.
whatItMeans: Warm and festive; a recurring jester mascot logo ties five differently coloured cards into one campaign.
techniques: Anchor a multi-colour card set with one consistent mascot logo.
Mix real photography with illustrated props like balloons and confetti.
Vary background colour per card while keeping typography fixed.

vocabulary.definition: A small character-based logo used as a recurring brand marker.
A group of vertical social posts designed to be viewed in sequence.
